name: MariaDB
description: MySQL 兼容的关系数据库，装完即设为开机自启并启动
note: root 账号默认走 unix_socket 认证：本机 root 用户可直接 mysql 登录，远程连接需另建账号

actions.label: 版本信息
actions.command: mariadb --version 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $5}' | cut -d- -f1 || mysql --version | awk '{print $5}' | cut -d- -f1 2>/dev/null | head -1

actions.label: 服务状态
actions.command:
unit=""
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  for u in 'mariadb'; do
    if systemctl cat "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1; then unit="$u"; break; fi
  done
fi
if [ -z "$unit" ]; then
  for u in 'mariadb'; do
    if [ -x "/etc/init.d/$u" ]; then unit="$u"; break; fi
  done
fi
[ -n "$unit" ] || unit='mariadb'
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl cat "$unit" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  systemctl status "$unit" --no-pager
elif command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  rc-service "$unit" status
else
  echo '未找到服务单元：mariadb'
  exit 1
fi

actions.label: 最近日志
actions.command:
unit=""
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  for u in 'mariadb'; do
    if systemctl cat "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1; then unit="$u"; break; fi
  done
fi
if [ -z "$unit" ]; then
  for u in 'mariadb'; do
    if [ -x "/etc/init.d/$u" ]; then unit="$u"; break; fi
  done
fi
[ -n "$unit" ] || unit='mariadb'
if command -v journalctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  journalctl -u "$unit" -n 80 --no-pager
else
  echo '该主机没有 journalctl，请到系统日志窗口查看 mariadb'
fi

actions.confirm: 启动后服务会立即对外提供能力。
actions.command:
unit=""
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  for u in 'mariadb'; do
    if systemctl cat "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1; then unit="$u"; break; fi
  done
fi
if [ -z "$unit" ]; then
  for u in 'mariadb'; do
    if [ -x "/etc/init.d/$u" ]; then unit="$u"; break; fi
  done
fi
[ -n "$unit" ] || unit='mariadb'
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl cat "$unit" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  systemctl start "$unit"
elif command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  rc-service "$unit" start
else
  echo '未找到服务单元：mariadb'

actions.command:
unit=""
